title: Speeding up TypeScript monorepo build times

parts.text: My TypeScript monorepo uses Nx with 24 packages. Full build takes 11 minutes on CI. Local incremental builds are fine but CI always does a cold build. How do I fix this?
We already use project references. The bottleneck seems to be the `@internal/ui` package — it re-compiles everything even when only `@internal/api` changes. Our tsconfig.json paths might be wrong.

If `@internal/ui` recompiles when only `@internal/api` changes, your `references` in `packages/ui/tsconfig.json` likely includes `@internal/api` unnecessarily. Check:

```bash
# Show what ui actually imports from api
grep -r 'from.*@internal/api' packages/ui/src --include='*.ts' | head -20
```

If there are no imports, remove the reference:
```json
// packages/ui/tsconfig.json — BEFORE (wrong)
{
  "references": [
    { "path": "../core" },
    { "path": "../api" }   // <-- remove if ui doesn't import from api
  ]
}
```

Also verify each package's `tsconfig.json` has `composite: true` and `declarationMap: true`:
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "composite": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": true,
    "incremental": true,
    "tsBuildInfoFile": ".tsbuildinfo"
  }
}
```
The `.tsbuildinfo` file is what enables incremental builds — make sure CI caches it alongside build artifacts.
